ingredients.title: Jam
items: 7 cups washed, peeled, and crushed peaches
2 pkg frozen raspberries or 2 heaping cups fresh raspberries

ingredients.title: Bottling
items: 6-7 pint jars, with lids and rings

instructions.title: Jam
items: Mix peaches, sugar, and berries together in a big pot and bring to boil over medium-high heat, stirring constantly.
Scrape down sugar from sides of pan and add 2 Tbsp butter to keep the foam down. Boil this for 15 minutes.
Take off heat. Add the jello. Stir in slowly so it doesn't get on the sides. Stir until jello is dissolved.

instructions.title: Bottling
items: Sterilize 6-7 pint jars. Heat lids on low in water.
When ready, fill jars 1/2 inch from the top. DO NOT scrape pan into jars; it turns to sugar!
Wipe rims of jam clean, add lids, adjust rings, and tighten.
Invert jam bottles for 8 minutes and then tip back up.
Store away from draft to seal completely.
Add 1 more cup of fruit to make ice cream syrup.
